description: Search patent and 3GPP material from a technical idea, invention description, or text query. IPscreener creates a search case in your account and retrieves matching records for review. Refine searches with company or inventor, classification, keyword, and date filters. Check searches that are still running, retrieve up to 50 results at a time, and request available search statistics. Designed for researchers, engineers, and innovation teams exploring relevant technical material. Requires an IPscreener account with access to the selected database.

defaultPrompt: Find patents about liquid cooling channels in electric vehicle battery enclosures.
